name: Vanilla rice pudding
steps: Cook the rice in the milk over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Add the maple syrup and vanilla at the end of cooking.
Serve warm, dusted with cinnamon.

name: Mango banana smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth.
Serve with a spoon or in a sippy cup, depending on age.

name: Chewy granola bars
steps: Gently warm the peanut butter, honey and oil.
Pour over the oats, raisins and nuts, then mix well.
Press firmly into a parchment-lined pan.
Bake at 160 °C for 20 minutes, then cool completely before cutting.

name: Vanilla chia pudding
steps: Whisk the chia, milk, syrup and vanilla.
Refrigerate for 4 hours, whisking once after 30 minutes.
Top with blueberries just before serving.

name: Yogurt dip with vegetable sticks
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry in a clean cloth.
Stir into the yogurt with the lemon and garlic.
Serve with vegetables prepared to suit the child's age.

name: Chicken couscous
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the diced chicken and brown it.
Pour in the broth, add the carrot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the couscous, cover and let it swell for 5 minutes.

name: Creamy shrimp and pea risotto
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil until translucent.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute, then add the broth one ladle at a time, stirring.
In the last 5 minutes, add the peas and the shrimp.
Remove from the heat and stir in the parmesan.
